actual_business_model: Non-clinical office for producing and making medical information, books and podcasts accessible to the public; no patient intake, diagnosis, treatment or appointments.

visibility_evidence.current_manager_search_view: Business Profile panel shown above organic results
visibility_evidence.conclusion: The profile is live and receiving Search and Maps exposure. It is not absent from Google; organic web ranking and the local Business Profile are separate surfaces.

current_profile_semantics.description_focus: Medical information, women's health, books and the official website

diagnosis.summary: The profile is visible, but its categories and several attributes describe a patient-facing clinic rather than the owner's stated non-clinical publishing and information office.

recommended_exact_changes_pending_owner_.description: המשרד של גיא רופא מפיק ומנגיש לציבור תוכן רפואי מבוסס בעברית, ספרים ופודקאסטים בנושאי בריאות האישה, הריון, לידה ופוריות. הפעילות במקום היא פעילות תוכן, הוצאה לאור ומדיה בלבד; אין במקום קבלת מטופלות, אבחון, טיפול רפואי או קביעת תורים.
review_before_change: Keep the public address and opening hours only if visitors can actually meet the business in person there during those hours.
Keep a service area only if the business actually visits customers in person in that area.
Review products and services after the category change and remove any clinical service entries.
recommended_exact_changes_pending_owner_.warning: Google may require reverification after a category change.
